title: Adds Deploy to Connect Cloud buttons to READMEs of the examples
description: This PR adds a button to the README of each example html doc that allows users to quickly deploy the doc to Connect Cloud and see it in action—with one click of the button. The PR does not otherwise affect the code in the examples or the repository. The buttons look like this. When I tested it, every doc deployed within seconds. **Why add Deploy to Connect Cloud buttons?** [Connect Cloud](https://connect.posit.cloud/) is part of Posit's strategy to provide value to Python users. With Connect Cloud, users can very quickly deploy and maintain Quarto assets straight from their Github repository. We believe in Connect Cloud as a company and want to highlight it alongside our own assets.

title: Updated Tufte Example
description:
The quarto file was not rendering correctly due to empty lines in the YAML block, failing to move citations and references to the margin. Likely related to [issue #3560](https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/issues/3560).

Additional updates:
- Increased the margin width with the new page layout feature introduced in Quarto 1.3.x to fit with Tufte's style
- Added missing book title in the skeleton.bib file
- Enabled `echo: fenced`. Since the document is frequently referring to chunk options, explicitly showing the code provides more educational value to those just reading the html file. 
- Added code annotations to the first YAML block
- New callout tip to explain the difference between chunk options within the curly brackets and those set via YAML
